fault_timing: After the isolated public-test tool returns success and its operation ledger is fsynced, before the matching VARE AgentStep can be appended. On restart, basic replays from step zero; VARE resumes from its last committed step.
hardware: Apple MacBook Pro M1 Pro, 32 GiB; control process local; candidate public tests isolated in Colima Docker.
scope: Deterministic two-tool recovery systems smoke using an already exposed development task. This does not measure model capability or generalize to hostile tools.
stop_rule: Abort before the first trial if the pinned ARM64 container image is missing, E0 candidate isolation canary fails, source/test hashes drift, free swap is below 512 MiB, or disk free is below 15 GiB. Preserve crashes and partial evidence.
success_rule: All 12 runs end with the public test passing. Under fault injection, VARE commits step zero before the crash, resumes at step one, and performs fewer tool operations than restart-from-scratch. No claim is made about delayed hidden graders, optimizer recovery, or real model inference interruption.
tool_contract: write_file is deterministic/idempotent; public_test is read-only. Operation IDs are recorded in the outer evidence ledger. The durable store guarantees resumable step cursor and hash-chain integrity, not external exactly-once execution.
